annotation.title_clean: 关于进一步推进职业健康保护行动提升劳动者职业健康素养水平的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice on Further Advancing the Occupational Health Protection Action and Improving Workers' Occupational Health Literacy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家卫生健康委办公厅; 教育部办公厅; 人力资源社会保障部办公厅; 住房城乡建设部办公厅; 交通运输部办公厅; 应急管理部办公厅; 国家疾控局综合司; 全国总工会办公厅
annotation.summary_en: Chinese multi-ministry notice (2024) directing local authorities to strengthen workers' occupational health literacy through employer training, literacy monitoring of key groups, outreach to institutions, enterprises, schools, villages and communities, and science-communication platforms. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Employers must carry out occupational health training and disclose workplace hazard test results
Provincial health authorities monitor occupational health literacy of key worker groups
Five-sector outreach: institutions, enterprises, schools, villages, communities
Build provincial occupational health science resource libraries open to the public
Provincial reports due to the National Health Commission each December 15
